fields.finding: BASF capacity is a humid-equilibrium number; the 10 wt% usable vacuum capacity is assumed. The SAES UHV capacity illustration is not a mixed-gas rough-vacuum recommendation. COMBO removes N2 at room temperature, but the opened page supplies no sizing capacity. Getter-retained external gas still adds vehicle mass.
fields.proposed_next: Obtain service-pressure mixed-gas capacity/rate and cartridge mass; do not treat a water bed as a complete air getter or as recovered lift.
